sources.notes: All-area ANA domestic timetable. Includes ANA marketed flights and operating company codes.

Official JAL timetable XML route files for currently available spring period. Collector includes JAL/JTA/RAC rows and skips FDA/AMX/ORC codeshare-operated rows to avoid duplicate physical flights. July-August official timetable is still pending.

ANA-derived JAC split artifact is kept as a cache only and is not used in the current bundle. Current JAL group flights come from official JAL timetable XML; standalone JAC summer labeling remains a source gap until JAL exposes that period/operator split.
Official Skymark timetable PDF. Composite [Via ...] displays are skipped so only physical flight legs are emitted.

Official AIRDO route tables. Many ADO flights also appear as ANA-marketed records, so cross-source merge must keep one physical flight. Current collector treats parsed notes as time/customer notices and expands all rows to the published period.
Official Solaseed Air PDF is cached and its image timetable rows are transcribed into an operator artifact. The current bundle uses this official source instead of ANA operatingCarrier fallback.
Official StarFlyer route timetable pages. Embedded route rows inside another route page are skipped; many records overlap ANA-marketed SFJ flights.
Official Fuji Dream Airlines route pages. Collector parses 2026 summer tab route tables, skips connection-guide content, and expands marked operating-date notes.
Official IBEX timetable page. The page repeats flights by airport section, so collector dedupes repeated physical rows. All current IBX records overlap ANA-marketed IBX records.

Official ORC route PDFs are cached and parsed directly. The current bundle uses ORC official rows instead of ANA operatingCarrier fallback; overlapping ANA official calendars are retained only when they provide route/date notes for the same physical row.

Official AMX public timetable images are cached and transcribed into an operator artifact, including the Kumamoto-Itami route that was absent from ANA fallback. The current bundle uses this official source.
Official Toki Air schedule page. Collector parses published period blocks, Japanese weekday notes, and listed extra operating dates.
Official Peach domestic summer PDF. Collector parses physical rows and expands explicit operating-date tokens; some PDF line splits may still need visual QA.

Official Jetstar Japan domestic PDF. Physical rows are parsed by PDF column; explicit dates, Japanese weekday operation/suspension notes, full-month notes, relative weekday notes, and complement rows are expanded with zero unresolved calendar notes.
Official Spring Japan domestic PDF is cached. Physical rows and multi-line period/weekday calendars are parsed with zero unresolved calendar notes.
